# FlightSweeper WebMCP Challenge Edition

FlightSweeper is a synthetic reference experience for browser agents. A traveler creates a bounded mission. WebMCP exposes only the tools valid for the current mission state. The application—not the model—enforces route, fare, price, quote freshness, confirmation mode, revocation, and idempotency.

No real inventory, supplier, payment method, passenger identity, reservation, or ticketing system is connected. All offers and receipts are deterministic challenge fixtures stored in the visitor's browser.

The browser-local tool surface is published at https://webmcp.flightsweeper.com/agent-tools.json. The public remote MCP at https://webmcp.flightsweeper.com/mcp exposes documentation and fixture metadata only; it cannot inspect or change a visitor's mission.
